project_budget_revisions_approval_metada.name: project_budget_revisions_approval_metadata_check
project_budget_revisions_approval_metada.value: "app"."project_budget_revisions"."status" NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED', 'CLOSED') OR ("app"."project_budget_revisions"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."project_budget_revisions"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

project_budgets_approval_metadata_check.name: project_budgets_approval_metadata_check
project_budgets_approval_metadata_check.value: ("app"."project_budgets"."status" NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED', 'CLOSED')) OR ("app"."project_budgets"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."project_budgets"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

change_orders_approval_metadata_check.name: change_orders_approval_metadata_check
change_orders_approval_metadata_check.value: "app"."change_orders"."status" NOT IN ('APPROVED', 'PENDING_CLIENT_APPROVAL', 'CLIENT_APPROVED', 'EFFECTED') OR ("app"."change_orders"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."change_orders"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

change_orders_client_approval_metadata_c.name: change_orders_client_approval_metadata_check
change_orders_client_approval_metadata_c.value: "app"."change_orders"."status" NOT IN ('CLIENT_APPROVED', 'EFFECTED') OR NOT "app"."change_orders"."client_approval_required" OR ("app"."change_orders"."client_approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."change_orders"."client_approved_at" IS NOT NULL)

change_orders_rejection_metadata_check.name: change_orders_rejection_metadata_check
change_orders_rejection_metadata_check.value: "app"."change_orders"."status" <> 'REJECTED' OR ("app"."change_orders"."rejected_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."change_orders"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."change_orders"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL)

change_orders_effect_metadata_check.name: change_orders_effect_metadata_check
change_orders_effect_metadata_check.value: "app"."change_orders"."status" <> 'EFFECTED' OR ("app"."change_orders"."effected_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."change_orders"."effected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."change_orders"."effected_budget_revision_id" IS NOT NULL)

change_orders_void_metadata_check.name: change_orders_void_metadata_check
change_orders_void_metadata_check.value: "app"."change_orders"."status" <> 'VOIDED' OR ("app"."change_orders"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."change_orders"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)

financial_audit_amount_requires_currency.name: financial_audit_amount_requires_currency
financial_audit_amount_requires_currency.value: "app"."financial_audit_events"."amount" IS NULL OR "app"."financial_audit_events"."currency_code" IS NOT NULL

cost_transactions_source_pair_check.name: cost_transactions_source_pair_check
cost_transactions_source_pair_check.value: ("app"."cost_transactions"."source_type" = 'MANUAL' AND ("app"."cost_transactions"."source_id" IS NULL OR char_length("app"."cost_transactions"."source_id") > 0)) OR ("app"."cost_transactions"."source_type" IN ('DOCUMENT', 'TASK', 'PHASE') AND "app"."cost_transactions"."source_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."cost_transactions"."source_type" = 'VOID_REVERSAL' AND "app"."cost_transactions"."source_id" IS NULL)

cost_transactions_quantity_unit_check.name: cost_transactions_quantity_unit_check
cost_transactions_quantity_unit_check.value: ("app"."cost_transactions"."quantity" IS NULL AND "app"."cost_transactions"."unit" IS NULL AND "app"."cost_transactions"."unit_cost" IS NULL) OR ("app"."cost_transactions"."quantity" > 0 AND "app"."cost_transactions"."unit" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("app"."cost_transactions"."unit") BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND "app"."cost_transactions"."unit_cost" >= 0)

cost_transactions_amounts_check.name: cost_transactions_amounts_check
cost_transactions_amounts_check.value: ("app"."cost_transactions"."source_type" = 'VOID_REVERSAL' AND "app"."cost_transactions"."subtotal" <= 0 AND "app"."cost_transactions"."tax_amount" <= 0 AND "app"."cost_transactions"."total_amount" <= 0) OR ("app"."cost_transactions"."source_type" <> 'VOID_REVERSAL' AND "app"."cost_transactions"."subtotal" >= 0 AND "app"."cost_transactions"."tax_amount" >= 0 AND "app"."cost_transactions"."total_amount" >= 0)

cost_transactions_post_metadata_check.name: cost_transactions_post_metadata_check
cost_transactions_post_metadata_check.value: "app"."cost_transactions"."status" NOT IN ('POSTED', 'VOIDED') OR ("app"."cost_transactions"."posted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."cost_transactions"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."cost_transactions"."posting_date" IS NOT NULL)

cost_transactions_void_metadata_check.name: cost_transactions_void_metadata_check
cost_transactions_void_metadata_check.value: "app"."cost_transactions"."status" <> 'VOIDED' OR ("app"."cost_transactions"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."cost_transactions"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)

cost_transactions_reversal_check.name: cost_transactions_reversal_check
cost_transactions_reversal_check.value: ("app"."cost_transactions"."source_type" = 'VOID_REVERSAL' AND "app"."cost_transactions"."reversal_of_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."cost_transactions"."status" = 'POSTED') OR ("app"."cost_transactions"."source_type" <> 'VOID_REVERSAL' AND "app"."cost_transactions"."reversal_of_id" IS NULL)

project_subcontractors_dates_check.name: project_subcontractors_dates_check
project_subcontractors_dates_check.value: "app"."project_subcontractors"."start_date" IS NULL OR "app"."project_subcontractors"."end_date" IS NULL OR "app"."project_subcontractors"."end_date" >= "app"."project_subcontractors"."start_date"

corrective_actions_verified_fields_check.name: corrective_actions_verified_fields_check
corrective_actions_verified_fields_check.value:
("app"."corrective_actions"."status" = 'VERIFIED' AND "app"."corrective_actions"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."corrective_actions"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "app"."corrective_actions"."status" <> 'VERIFIED'
